configuration: the pin file may carry a trust_anchors list of {path, sha256}; the digest is verified at load time, the anchor DER is passed to the bundled legacy verifier, and a missing verifier or anchor mismatch fails closed
notes: anchors are optional; without them the documented leaf-pinning model is unchanged
a fresh NSS database is created per exchange so anchors cannot leak between hosts
PKIX is still unavailable in this build; verification uses CERT_VerifyCertNow
